issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 08 uses SELECT * (returning all columns) while the problem statement explicitly requires only Name, Landkreis, Fläche and the Einwohnerzahlen. This structural mismatch may confuse students because the reference solution returns more columns than requested and does not demonstrate selecting the specific columns the task asks for.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution (and optionally the template) for Aufgabe 08 to explicitly select only the requested columns. For example: SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100; This ensures the reference matches the task specification and avoids returning unintended columns.
